assessment_summary: The paper uses an inversion formula to express the Mertens function in terms of sums of the Piltz divisor function, then uses known estimates to derive zero-free regions for the Riemann zeta function and bound the Landau-Siegel zero. Every step in the proof of Theorem 3 (Landau-Siegel zero bound) is rigorously justified: the shifted contour integration relies correctly on the fact that $g_\chi(s)$ is an entire function, removing the pole at $s=1+\beta_0$. The matrix inversion leading to the inversion formula matches the explicit Dirichlet inverse formula. The asymptotic evaluations and balancing of parameters perfectly yield $\beta_0 \le 1 - c/\log q$.
